name: g_walk
setup: m.stage0({s: 6.0, gait: 'walk'}); m.simulate(0.4); const p = m.dummy.root.position, y = m.dummy.root.rotation.y, sg = -Math.sin(y) >= 0 ? 1 : -1; v.pos = [p.x + sg * Math.cos(y) * 3.0, 1.0, p.z - sg * Math.sin(y) * 3.0]; v.target = [p.x, 0.75, p.z];
